hero_title: No Indian brand should grow alone.
hero_text: Zeroing is a community of Indian brands and the people behind them. We open doors for each other, and we keep an honest record of how work in this country actually gets done.

bands.title: The community
bands.text: Indian brands made with intent. One brand's customer finds another. One founder's supplier helps the next.

bands.title: Independent Society
bands.text: Our podcast. One person, one long honest conversation about what their working life in India actually looked like.

bands.title: The Other Details
bands.text: Our research lab. The money, the paperwork, the years nobody saw. Written down, with sources.

craft_text: Turmeric before it is a gel. A camera on the sand for a shot of ants. This is the part Zeroing is for: the making, the hands, the years. Every photograph here comes from a brand in the community, a guest, or our own shoot.

brands_title: Made here, by people you can meet.
brands_text: Every brand in Zeroing is homegrown and made in India, as its founder has told us. We ask each one to say plainly what it already does on materials, packaging or making, and what it will do next. Buy from them directly.
how_text: Three things we look after. Every brand, episode and study in Zeroing answers to them.

pillars.title: Nature
pillars.line: We give time to the people who look after it.
points: Independent Society begins with a wildlife filmmaker who has spent two decades on the species few channels commission.
Brands build on what grows here: turmeric, saffron, honey, coffee, orange.
The Other Details traces what our habits cost the land, like the water behind the cloud.

pillars.title: Culture
pillars.line: We keep what India already made.
points: Vedi Kade carries Tamil history into clothes for an ordinary day.
INDSO starts from haldi doodh, a preparation Indian homes have made for generations.
Every episode opens with a voice from 15 August 1947 and closes with a promise.

pillars.title: Sustainability
pillars.line: We ask every brand for one honest next step.
points: No brand here is called sustainable by us. Each brand page shows what the founder says it does now on materials, packaging or making, and what comes next, or says the answer is still to come.
Brands are introduced to each other's suppliers, stalls and customers, so fewer of them build alone.
We grow at the makers' pace, one founder conversation at a time.
